function flush(){ if(s!="") {gsub(/"/,"\"\"",subj); printf "%s,%s,\"%s\",%d,%d,%d\n",s,d,subj,f,a,r}}
/^@@/{flush(); s=substr($1,3); d=$2; subj=$3; for(i=4;i<=NF;i++)subj=subj"|"$i; f=a=r=0; next}
NF{split($0,t,"\t"); if(t[1]!="-"){a+=t[1];r+=t[2]} f++}
END{flush()}'; } > commit-activity.csv
wc -l commit-activity.csv; head -3 commit-activity.csv
